name: sealskin
description: SealSkin mobile shell (Capacitor). The web dir is copied from client/dist/mobile.

scripts.build: rm -rf www && (cd ../client && ([ -d node_modules ] || npm ci --no-audit --no-fund) && SEALSKIN_BUILD_STRICT=1 npm run build --silent -- --target mobile) && cp -r ../client/dist/mobile www && node gen-assets.mjs
scripts.android: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
